confidence_notes: Havana price indexes are sparse and volatile, and July prices are approximate. Visitor-dollar and local CUP prices can differ substantially. comparable_city_reasoning: Food anchors use Havana-specific aggregate price indexes. Accommodation estimates reflect Havana’s casa-particular and limited budget-hostel context, with broad Caribbean budget-tourism levels as a guide.
